text:
maria-partners: Starting a quick thread for cloud marketplace publisher onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Top concerns: KMS handshake, trial entitlement mapping, image retention SLA, and telemetry gating. Who can pick up which lane?

nate-cloud: I can do cloud steps. Quick callouts: AWS Private Offer needs BYOK/KMS ARN handling; GCP supports CMEK on images; Azure prefers customer-managed keys via Key Vault. Need to coordinate key policy docs.

elaine-ops: Ops will own KMS integration tests and retention/runbooks. Proposed retention: keep published images + snapshots for 90 days, archive audit copies for 1 year. If marketplaces require 120d, we can extend.

sam-legal: I'll handle terms + DPA checks. Please surface whether we host any customer secrets in images. Also, require that marketing/demo assets use synthetic data. Add clause for key ownership and revocation in the SLA.

raj-product: Packaging lead here. Plan: one AMI / one GCP image / one Azure VM image. Trial entitlement: 14 days default, mapping to internal license JWT. Will include sample manifest and small `startup.sh` that toggles telemetry.

liam-marketing: I'll prep screenshots and a 20-30s clip. Reminder: marketplace thumbnails must not contain logos over required sizes and must match vendor guidelines. Also, need a short blurb for the listing that mentions "bring-your-own-key" support where applicable.

maria-partners: Owners note: raj = packaging, elaine = ops/runbooks, nate = cloud steps, sam = legal, liam = marketing. Timeline: packaging draft in 48h, legal draft 72h, ops runbook 5d, cloud steps 5d, assets 7d. Agree?

raj-product: Confirmed. I'll attach manifest sample and IAM snippet. Example `cloud-iam.yaml`:
```yaml
roles:
  - name: publisher-role
    aws_actions: [ec2:RegisterImage, ec2:ModifyImageAttribute, s3:PutObject]
    gcp_roles: [compute.images.create]
```

elaine-ops: For S3/GCS lifecycle, propose: keep current copies 90d, then move to Glacier/Archive. Example lifecycle rule: `expiration: 120d` for published artifacts.

listing-bot: task-created: marketplace-pub-checklist by maria-partners at 1769555620

nate-cloud: For KMS handoff on AWS: request the customer supply a KMS key ARN and add our publisher role as a grantee (we'll provide minimal IAM policy). For BYOK flow we'll include a preflight script to verify key policy.

sam-legal: Adding to checklist: export-control scan for included crypto libraries; KMS ownership clause; data-processing addendum alignment; marketing consent checkbox.

liam-marketing: Quick question: can demo images have telemetry off by default? We don't want to trigger privacy review.

raj-product: Yes, add env var `REDSH_IP_MARKET_TELEMETRY=false` in startup and document how to opt-in. We'll include that in quickstart.

elaine-ops: Ops will run an integration test that verifies telemetry toggle and confirms no outbound calls to prod telemetry endpoints.

maria-partners: Risk register (brief): key policy mismatch, entitlement JWT mapping errors, marketplace metadata mismatch. I'll create a small shared sheet and assign severity.

listing-bot: reminder: checklist-updated at 1769555900 by raj-product

sam-legal: I'll post the legal checklist in the shared sheet and flag any blocking clauses within 72h.

maria-partners: Thanks all. I'll DM the marketplace account reps and schedule a 30m sync if needed. Ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark:
